page.overview:
What is California King Bed?

A toy-like apparatus, California King Bed is composed of a head and five smaller connected units, loosely representing a torso and limbs; all bearing a smiley face. The head is composed of what looks like a U-shaped travel cushion, both ends topped by a simple daisy-like flower; bordering a sort of smiley, surrounded by four large petals, with a cheerful open-mouthed smile (comparable to that featuring in 's work Smile.

In the colored manga, California King Bed is purple, bright yellow and pink.

California King Bed's ability allows for it to steal particular memories from a person under certain conditions. While fairly harmless and fitting for the playful Daiya, it becomes rather menacing on people like the amnesiac Josuke, as Daiya can effectively brainwash them.

When California King Bed first activated, it seemed to create a large gash on Daiya's leg, Although when Josuke checked the gash was no longer there. It is unclear whether this was another aspect to California King Beds ability or not.
